name: Transporter 18 (Dedicated SSO Rideshare)
slot_a_text: Dedicated rideshare flight to a sun-synchronous orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers.
slot_b_text: B1082 is flying for the 25th time. It flies back to Landing Zone 4 rather than a drone ship. Its previous trip was Starlink Group 15-22, 36 days ago.
description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a sun-synchronous orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers.
rocket_fact: Max-Q is the point during ascent when a rocket experiences its highest dynamic pressure, caused by the combination of air density and speed.
